Q: When would I use Task.Yield()? A:

I once had to do a lot of CPU-intensive work looping over WPF controls and manipulating them, which had to run on the UI thread so the UI would freeze, and the whole thing could take up to a minute to finish, so I used Task.Yield(); at different points in my control loop to keep the UI responsive.

Q: Creating windows in OpenGl A:

You will just re-invent the wheel. You can look at the source code for GLFW and learn from it, but you will never have the variety of platforms that GLFW has been tested on. In general, creating an OpenGL context is not something that needs to be optimized. It just needs to be done right.

Q: How do I run a Webapp and WebService in Eclipse? (Gradle, Spring Boot, Wicket) A:

I solved it myself:

  • for Webapp

    • install Spring boot from Eclipse marketplace

    • run your class which inherits from SpringBootServletInitializer as Spring Boot App

  • for WebService

    • run your class as java application
